name.ja: BB戦士321 馬超ブルーデスティニー
name.en: BB Senshi 321 Horse Super Blue Destiny

description.ja: ●三国伝新章の主人公「神威の錦馬超」こと“馬超ブルーディスティニー”が出陣！ ●鎧を組み替え、髪パーツを逆立てて、通常形態から暴走形態に変形 ●頭部のつまみを回して目を通常モードから暴走モードへ変えるギミック搭載 ●武器「獅龍極煉槍（しりゅうごくれんそう）」は剣や槍などの複数の武器に分解可能
description.en: ●The main character of the new chapter of Sangokuden, “Kamii Nishikibacho”, also known as “Umacho Blue Destiny”, is out! -Transform from normal form to runaway form by rearranging the armor and standing on end of the hair parts -Equipped with a gimmick that changes the eyes from normal mode to runaway mode by turning the knob on the head -Weapon "Shiryu Gokurensou" can be disassembled into multiple weapons such as swords and spears
